text:
incident-bot: PAGE — elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts detected on inference-gateway-v2. Error rate spiked from ~0.2% to 8% in the last 3m. Alerts: gateway-5xx-high, scheduler-queue-depth. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/abcd (SLO breach potential). Severity: P1

maria_oncall: i'm paged, looking at graphs now. joining via call. cc @lee_sre @chris_eng

lee_sre: on my way. first glance: scheduler queue length jumped ~x10 across region-us-east-1, lots of long-waiting batches. traces show requests stuck in batcher for >5s before timeout.

chris_eng: seeing repeated logs from scheduler: `queue_len=3420 head_wait_ms=8200 batch_size=128 target=kv-cache`. also gateway errors 502/504, TLS handshakes OK. suspect batching-induced HOL stall.

maria_oncall: can we temporarily route new traffic to the low-latency path (bypass batching) while we triage? want to reduce tail latency and stop customer-facing 5xx.

sara_ops: I can flip the route flag. doing canary to 10% first. running: 
```bash
curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' -d '{"route":"bypass_batch","pct":10}'
```

dev-bot: route change accepted — bypass_batch -> 10% for gateway-v2. config_id=rt-2026-07-21

jon_prod: customer-impact quick check: lookups show ~12 customers had elevated 5xx (top: acme-inc, betaapp, searchly). open tickets: 7 created automatically. informing support.

sam_support: escalating to account teams for top 3 customers now. posting status: "Investigating increased errors; temporary mitigation applied."

lee_sre: while bypass helps, queue is still heavy. need to relieve scheduler. options: 1) scale scheduler replicas, 2) reduce max_batch_size, 3) evict long-KV sessions. i can scale first.

chris_eng: scale + reduce batch. i'll apply a conservative batch cap to avoid massive tall batches: 
```yaml
# control-plane payload
{
  "service": "scheduler",
  "overrides": {"max_batch_size": 64, "batch_timeout_ms": 50}
}
```

maria_oncall: scaling scheduler to 6 replicas now. 
```bash
kubectl scale deploy/scheduler -n inference --replicas=6
```

dev-bot: deployment/scheduler scaled to 6 replicas.

sara_ops: applied batch cap to 64 for 100% of traffic. change_id=cfg-7781.

chris_eng: adding quick eviction for stale KV caches older than 30m: running script. this will free memory and reduce blocking.

maria_oncall: running `redis-cli` eviction for long sessions (confirming scope):
```bash
redis-cli -n 2 EVAL "--evict-script--" 0
```

lee_sre: logs show queue length dropping from 3400 -> 900 after scale+batch-cap+eviction. errors down but still spiky. gateway timeouts reduced from 12% -> 2.1% in last 5m.

jon_prod: support: customers still seeing intermittent errors but majority back to normal. patch notes to customers: temporary routing and scaling applied, full root cause analysis forthcoming.

sam_support: posted update to status.redwood.ai: "Partial mitigation in place; some customers may experience intermittent errors. Engineers are actively reducing queue pressure." :white_check_mark:

maria_oncall: from on-call timeline: paged 3961112222 -> mitigation applied within 9m (route 10% -> scale -> config). moving to recovery phase. leaving a watch for 30m and will re-evaluate.

lee_sre: still seeing a small class of requests causing long KV writes that stall batches (pattern: large embedding requests with streaming enabled). marking them as a mitigation target: throttle streaming large-embeds or force-rewrite to non-batched path.

chris_eng: I've added an automatic fallback for requests with tokens > 2000 to always take non-batched low-latency path. patch deployed.

maria_oncall: error rate stabilized around 0.3% now, latency P95 back to baseline. last customer-impacting spike 12m ago. setting postmortem owner.

maria_oncall: postmortem assigned to lee_sre. follow-ups:
- add circuit-breaker when queue_len > 1000 to auto-bypass batching
- improved metrics for per-customer 5xx attribution
- tune default batch_size heuristics based on token distribution
- run chaos test for scheduler saturation scenarios

lee_sre: will own the postmortem and run a tabletop tomorrow. assigning ticket: INF-4521.

jon_prod: notify sales/CS for impacted accounts (acme-inc/betaapp/searchly) and offer post-incident review.

maria_oncall: closing live-handoff. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. thanks everyone for quick response. :pray:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced, severity degraded to P3. next update scheduled in 24h or on postmortem publish.
